svg.text: Plate 250 x 250 x 20, high-strength steel (do not swap to mild steel).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two hand slots 24 x 90, centred 30 mm in from two opposite edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ring 92 outside, 72 inside, 15 tall, on the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the ring with a 6 mm fillet all round, low-hydrogen rods,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: preheat as the plate maker's sheet says; let it cool slowly.
